method.method_draft: Use triangle ADB directly. From the text, use AB=1 and BC=2. Since ABCD is a rectangle, AD=BC=2 and AB is perpendicular to AD, so triangle ADB is right-angled at A. From the image, take the rectangle orientation as A upper left, B lower left, C lower right, D upper right, with BD the diagonal whose angle with DA is requested. From the text, AB=1 and BC=2, so the rectangle has width 2 and height 1. Assign coordinates D=(0,0), A=(-2,0), and B=(-2,-1).
